title: GEORGE BELL 1988 TOPPS BASEBALL - CARD #390 - TORONTO BLUE JAYS - ALL STAR
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1988 Topps baseball trading card featuring George Bell of the Toronto Blue Jays. The card, number #390, showcases Bell as an All-Star player. It is not autographed and does not come with authentication. This card is part of the base set and is a collectible item for fans of baseball memorabilia.
